# Ollama

Run large language models locally or in the cloud with Ollama

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/ollama/.

## Actions

- **Chat with Ollama model** (read-only): Send a chat message with conversation history to Ollama.
- **Generate Text with Ollama** (read-only): Generate text responses from Ollama models with optional raw mode.
- **List Models** (read-only): List all available Ollama models and their details.
- **OpenAI-Compatible Chat Completion** (read-only): Create OpenAI-compatible chat completions using Ollama models.
- **OpenAI-Compatible Text Completion** (read-only): Create OpenAI-compatible text completions using Ollama models.
- **Show Model Information** (read-only): Show comprehensive information about an Ollama model.
- **Get Ollama Version** (read-only): Get the version of Ollama running locally.
- **List Models (OpenAI Compatible)** (read-only): List available models using OpenAI-compatible API format.
